motivation: Lawful0.1mm initial rack translations give first-impact current21point coordinate RMS0.072mm but mean100ms response-displacement disagreement13.539mm across20known centers. This is an observed motivation, not a new result of the forks.
question: Are the first-impact differences mediated by pin axial orientation/spin, other current rigid state differences, or simulator numerical memory?
sources: all20 validation centers and their four0.1mm x/y signed neighbors already generated under neighborhood_v1; same frozen actions; first eligible event query and target pin(s); no test access

arms.original_native: unaltered original query MjData; verify exact original100ms continuation
arms.original_forward: same original query MjData plus mj_forward only; recomputation control
arms.original_zero_warmstart: original query MjData, qacc_warmstart set0, mj_forward; qpos/qvel unchanged; algorithmic-memory intervention, not a new physical law
arms.neighbor_native: unaltered lawful-neighbor query MjData; verify exact saved neighbor100ms continuation
arms.neighbor_forward: same neighbor plus mj_forward only; paired recomputation control
arms.neighbor_axial_orientation_from_original: right-multiply each pin quaternion by a local-z rotation aligning its transverse x axis as closely as possible to original. Preserve pin axis, position and world angular velocity. No object translation or visible point-velocity change.
arms.neighbor_axial_spin_from_original: replace each pin world-angular-velocity component along its own long axis with original pin axial spin; preserve world perpendicular angular velocity, position and orientation
arms.neighbor_axial_both_from_original: combine the two axial interventions; same visible point positions and instantaneous velocities as neighbor
arms.neighbor_full_object_state_from_original: replace all11 object quaternions and6velocities with original values, keep neighbor object positions and robot; this includes visible and invisible state changes
arms.neighbor_all_qpos_qvel_from_original: replace whole qpos/qvel with original values but retain neighbor MjData numerical memory; mj_forward; isolates non-qpos/qvel state

runtime: unchanged model, integrator, solver, timestep, actions; restore copied native query data for each fork, run5controls=100ms. No model training. Capture native query states and all arm futures.
verification: original and neighbor native continuations must match saved trajectories bitwise; axial arms preserve21point current positions and instantaneous point velocities within1e-10. Reset query data independently each arm.
analysis: for original eligible first-impact pins, compare each arm's raw100ms endpoint displacement with original; endpoints then targets then20episode macro, average4 signed neighbors within center. Report every center/neighbor/arm and full native qpos/qvel hashes.
uncertainty: 10000 paired episode bootstrap,seed20261022; reused selected centers, mechanism diagnostic only

decision.axial_mediation: both-axial arm reduces disagreement vs neighbor_forward by>=50percent, paired95CI delta upper<0; report orientation/spin separately. Require baseline disagreement>5mm and disclose any nontrivial numerical-memory effects.
decision.other_state_mediation: if axial condition fails but full-object-state arm reduces disagreement>=50percent with pairedCI upper<0, observed difference is mainly mediated by other rigid state changes in this intervention; no unique architectural conclusion.
decision.numerical_memory: report original_zero_warmstart vs original_forward and restored-all-state vs original_forward; >1mm episode-macro disagreement is a material simulation-memory dependence requiring follow-up before attributing all error to object representation.
decision.none: if no separation, inspect contact timing/geometry and solver convergence under a separately frozen diagnostic; no claim of irreducible noise or point-history insufficiency.

limits: Axial forks are query-time interventions. They do not construct two reachable trajectories with identical entire observation histories.
Tiny initial shifts plus near point inputs do not prove exact information-theoretic ambiguity.
The privileged state network is not trained or compared in this control.
Physics parameters and learned outputs are not adjusted to improve metrics.
